reference_original_CdSe: Riedinger et al., How semiconductor nanoplatelets form, Nature Materials (2017); arXiv:1605.06553v2 with Supplementary Information
reference_independent_CdS_experiment: Knuesel et al., Experimental Evidence for Two-Dimensional Ostwald Ripening in Semiconductor Nanoplatelets, Chemistry of Materials 32 (2020), DOI:10.1021/acs.chemmater.0c01238

edge_eV_A.source: Riedinger SI  pp.26,32, S4.c; edge range 24–47 meV/Å

volume_eV_A3.source: Riedinger SI  p.33, S29-S30; 2 ML absent, 3 ML observed

prefactor_s1.source: Riedinger SI  p.30, S19-S21; normalized absorbance

equations.S1: ΔE = E_V ΔV + E_A ΔA + E_L ΔL
equations.S2: ΔE(a,P_island,L_step)=L1 E_V a + L1 E_A P_island + E_L (L_step+4L1)
equations.S3: minimum energy at fixed island area a (shape optimization)
equations.S4-S5: E_wide(a)=L1 E_V a+(4L1 E_A+2E_L) sqrt(a)+4L1 E_L
equations.S13-S18: x(t)=U exp(Λt) U^{-1} x(0) (if K diagonalizable)
equations.S29: dE_narrow,m/da=L1 E_V+2E_A/m<0 for favorable lateral growth

CdS_independent_observations.interpretation: 2-ML disappears below 160°C; thicker groups appear with increased temperature
CdS_independent_observations.source: Knuesel et al. 2020  pp.4-5, Methods and Figure 2; 2-ML/3-ML assignment via electron/light-hole transitions

barrier_model: S7 narrow-branch intercept approximation; not the full minimum-energy island path
note: Rates are model-derived predictions, NOT directly measured constants; nonlinear rate-law units require normalized dimensionless inventory.
